basis: C4 PEP carboxylase, mesophyll cytosol (in situ Langdale et al. 1988); MS DE in Bezrutczyk 2021 (logFC 3.2) and marks snRNA C5 MC in Zhao 2024 (ID inferred from enzyme name there); Sun 2022 called MC from PEPC (no ID given).

Carbonic anhydrase supplying HCO3- to PEPC in C4 mesophyll (Friso et al. 2010 proteomics); MS DE in Bezrutczyk 2021 (logFC 3.6), MC marker in Zhao 2024 (paralog inferred). Caution: Sun 2022 Fig 3C shows it in subsidiary cells as well as MC.
Chloroplast NADP-malate dehydrogenase of the C4 mesophyll step; MS DE in Bezrutczyk 2021 (pct 0.999 vs 0.245) and MC dotplot in Zhao 2024 (paralog inferred there).

Pyruvate,orthophosphate dikinase regenerating PEP in C4 mesophyll; only moderately MS-enriched in Bezrutczyk 2021 (logFC 1.45; some BS expression). Sun 2022 used PPDK for MC (no ID). Ortholog of the sorghum_leaf.tsv PPDK row.
PPDK regulatory protein, mesophyll-located in C4 maize; MS DE in Bezrutczyk 2021 (logFC 2.95).
Cytosolic glutamine synthetase immunolocalized to mesophyll (Martin et al. 2006 Plant Cell); MS-enriched with some BS in Bezrutczyk 2021 Supp Fig S5A.

Beta-glucosidase (benzoxazinoid glucoside hydrolase); in situ in abaxial mesophyll and mesophyll flanking lateral veins of P4 primordia; top gene of Yi 2026 c10 (palisade label revised to Mesophyll). Young leaf only.
Germin-like protein; mesophyll ring in cell-segmented Stereo-seq (Zhao 2024). ID inferred from MaizeGDB symbol glp1, not from the paper table (S13 inaccessible); raise to medium once confirmed.
IDD TF co-expressed with SCR1 in early MC; EMS allele reduces MC between veins (Zhao 2024 preprint, one allele). ID from MaizeGDB symbol idd7. Early primordia only.
IDD TF co-expressed with SCR1 in early MC; EMS allele reduces MC between veins (Zhao 2024 preprint, one allele). ID from MaizeGDB symbol iddp1. Early primordia only.

C4 NADP-malic enzyme decarboxylating malate in BS chloroplasts (in situ Langdale 1988); BS DE in Bezrutczyk 2021 (logFC 5.0, pct 1.00 vs 0.14) and snRNA C25 BSC in Zhao 2024 (ID inferred from enzyme name). Ortholog of the sorghum_leaf.tsv NADP-ME row.

Rubisco small subunit, BS-restricted in C4 leaves; in situ in all BS cells (Bezrutczyk 2021 Fig 2G) and BS ring in cell-resolution Stereo-seq (Zhao 2024; ID via symbol ssu1). High ambient background in droplet data (pct 0.60 outside BS), so use with ME and GDCSH.
Rubisco small subunit paralog; BS DE in Bezrutczyk 2021 (logFC 5.2, pct 1.00 vs 0.31) and in the BS Hotspot module M7 of Zhao 2024 (ID via symbol). Ambient background as for RBCS1.
PEP carboxykinase of the secondary BS decarboxylation route in maize (Friso et al. 2010 proteomics); BS DE in Bezrutczyk 2021 (pct 1.00 vs 0.09). Sun 2022 called BSC from PCK (no ID).
Glycine decarboxylase H protein; photorespiration is confined to BS in C4 leaves; cleanest BS DE gene in Bezrutczyk 2021 (pct 1.00 vs 0.036).
Phosphoribulokinase of the Calvin cycle, BS-located in C4 maize (Friso 2010); BS DE in Bezrutczyk 2021 (pct 0.98 vs 0.03).
Cytosolic glutamine synthetase immunolocalized to BS (Martin et al. 2006 Plant Cell); BS-enriched in Bezrutczyk 2021 Supp Fig S5B.

GARP TF required for BS chloroplast differentiation, BS-expressed in C4 maize leaves (Hall et al. 1998 Plant Cell); in the BS Hotspot module M7 of Zhao 2024. Low-abundance TF; NCBI text search for golden2 returns glk1 (wrong gene).

Clade III sucrose uniporter for apoplasmic phloem loading; abaxial BS of rank-2 veins by in situ and translational ProSWEET13a:SWEET13a-GUS (3 events) (Bezrutczyk 2021). Marks the abaxial BS subtype only (pct 0.95 vs 0.00 in other BS); also phloem parenchyma.
Clade III sucrose uniporter; abaxial BS (and PP) by in situ (Bezrutczyk 2021, pct 1.00 vs 0.16). Abaxial BS subtype only.
Clade III sucrose uniporter; abaxial BS (and PP) by in situ (Bezrutczyk 2021, pct 0.86 vs 0.09). Abaxial BS subtype only.

Sucrose export for phloem loading; in situ in PP of major veins (22.5% of signal) besides abaxial BS (Bezrutczyk 2021). Conflict: in the scRNA data it marks abaxial BS, since PP was not captured. Maize member of the sorghum_leaf.tsv SWEET13 row.
Sucrose export; in situ in PP as well as abaxial BS (Bezrutczyk 2021). Same caveat as SWEET13a.
Clade III SWEET; vascular in situ in P4 primordia and top gene of Yi 2026 c13 (pct 0.42 vs 0.01). c13 identity unresolved (PP vs BS precursor).

H+/sucrose symporter for phloem loading; sut1 mutant loading defect (Slewinski et al. 2009 J Exp Bot); in situ in companion cells, also vascular parenchyma of major veins (Bezrutczyk 2021). Conflict: Zhao 2024 assigns it to phloem parenchyma (ID via symbol). Not captured in Bezrutczyk scRNA. Ortholog of sorghum_leaf.tsv SUT1.
Callose synthase; developing phloem by in situ and top DE gene of Yi 2026 c11 (pct 0.97 vs 0.34).

NAC45/86-dependent exonuclease of sieve-element enucleation (Furuta et al. 2014, Arabidopsis); developing phloem in situ in maize primordia, c11 pct 0.52 vs 0.04 (Yi 2026). Differentiating SE only; enucleate SE are absent from nuclei data.
SMXL3 ortholog (protophloem SE formation in Arabidopsis, Wallner et al. 2017); DE in Yi 2026 c11 (pct 0.40 vs 0.10), not validated in maize.
Inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase of the CVP2/CVL1 family needed for protophloem SE (Arabidopsis); listed for SE precursors and DE in Yi 2026 c11; no maize validation.
Cytokinin-activating LOG enzyme; developing xylem in situ and Yi 2026 c12 DE (pct 0.52 vs 0.03).
WALLS ARE THIN1 ortholog (secondary-wall formation, Arabidopsis); developing xylem in situ, Yi 2026 c12 (pct 0.87 vs 0.07).

Caffeic acid O-methyltransferase; bm3 brown-midrib mutants have altered lignin; highly specific to Yi 2026 xylem c12. Also expected in other lignifying cells (sclerenchyma, BS cell walls) in mature leaves. UniProt Q06509 lists Zm00001d049541.
TMO5-LIKE1 homolog (xylem-precursor bHLH in Arabidopsis); very specific in Yi 2026 c12 (pct 0.47 vs 0.01), no maize validation.
TMO5-like bHLH; Yi 2026 c12 DE (pct 0.49 vs 0.06). v4 gene maps to two v5 models (Zm00001eb099390, Zm00001eb099400).

Auxin efflux carrier canalizing vein formation; pZmPIN1a::ZmPIN1a-YFP marks developing veins (Yi 2026) and pseudo-Kranz centre in Stereo-seq (Zhao 2024; ID via symbol). Also in xylem/vascular clusters c12/c13 and epidermal convergence points. v4 gene maps to two v5 models (eb372180 pin1, eb372190).
ANT-like AP2 TF; in situ in procambial initials and strands; mutant and overexpression change vein number/density (Yi 2026). Low detection in nuclei (c5 pct 0.41 vs 0.25).
G2-like TF; in situ in developing procambium and single procambial initials (Yi 2026 Supp Fig S5); also c13.
YABBY TF; in situ in developing procambium (Yi 2026 Supp Fig S5); c5 log2FC 2.3.
LAX-like auxin import carrier; in situ in middle-layer cells, highest in c5 (Yi 2026); also mGM. v4 gene maps to two v5 models (eb010460 aic3, eb010470).
ANT-like AP2 TF; in situ in middle ground meristem and procambial initials; EMS mutants change vein number/density (Yi 2026). Shared by mGM (c1) and procambium (c5).
ANT co-ortholog; in situ in procambial initials and mGM, DE in c5/c1/c3 (Yi 2026).
Serine carboxypeptidase-like; in situ restricted to undifferentiated mGM (Yi 2026), but also DE in xylem c12.

SCARECROW1; scr1 mutants alter mesophyll number between veins (Hughes et al. 2019 Curr Biol); early MC/BS in Stereo-seq co-expression (Zhao 2024). Also in stomatal precursors and SMC (Yi 2026 Table S5): not specific.
Benzoxazinoid P450; in situ in enlarged parenchyma near the midrib and large veins, Yi 2026 c8 (pct 0.77 vs 0.08). Defence gene: may mark a stress state.
Wound-induced Bowman-Birk inhibitor; in situ in midrib parenchyma and adaxial epidermis (Yi 2026). Wound-inducible, not specific.
Tonoplast aquaporin of vacuolating cells; in situ listed (Yi 2026 Table S1), c8 pct 0.66 vs 0.12.

Non-specific lipid transfer protein; outer-layer expression in cell-resolution Stereo-seq (Zhao 2024, ID via symbol plt3/UniProt B6SIF2) and epidermal marker DE in Yi 2026 epidermal clusters (ID in Yi Table S5). Two independent studies.
3-ketoacyl-CoA synthase for cuticular wax; ad1 mutants have fused organs; DE in Yi 2026 epidermal c0/c6.
ABCG transporter of epicuticular wax (glossy13); DE in Yi 2026 c0/c6.
Glycerol-3-phosphate acyltransferase of cutin synthesis; DE in Yi 2026 c0/c6.

Inward Shaker K+ channel for stomatal movement, GC-expressed (Gao et al. 2017 Plant J); used by Sun 2022 to call the GC cluster. ID from NCBI Gene alias (LOC542053), not from the paper table; v4 maps to two v5 models (eb120180, eb120190 kch4).
OST1/SnRK2 ABA kinase for stomatal closure; GC-specific promoter reporter, but in transgenic rice (Sun 2022 Fig 2C).
K+/H+ antiporter for stomatal opening (Arabidopsis CHX20); GC-specific reporter in transgenic rice (Sun 2022). Ortholog of sorghum_leaf.tsv CHX20 row (not checked by BLAST).
EF-hand Ca2+ sensor; GC-specific reporter in transgenic rice (Sun 2022 Fig 1D).
Cyclic nucleotide-gated channel; GC-specific reporter in transgenic rice (Sun 2022).
GDSL lipase; young-to-mature GC reporter in transgenic maize (Sun 2022 Fig 4E).
MFS transporter; GC-enriched (not specific) reporter in transgenic rice (Sun 2022).
Polygalacturonase; GC-enriched reporter in transgenic rice (Sun 2022).

Clade I SWEET glucose transporter localized only to subsidiary cells by eYFP/GUS; cst1 mutant has reduced stomatal opening (Wang et al. 2019 Plant Cell); native CST1-eYFP in young SCs and SC snRNA marker (Sun 2022). ID confirmed by NCBI Gene alias CST1 (GRMZM2G153358). Ortholog of sorghum_leaf.tsv CST1.
Cell-wall glycine-rich protein; SC-specific reporter in transgenic maize (Sun 2022 Fig 1C).
G-type lectin receptor kinase; SC-specific reporter in transgenic maize and rice (Sun 2022).
AKT1-like inward K+ channel expressed in SCs (Buchsenschutz et al. 2005 Planta); used by Sun 2022 for the SC cluster. ID from NCBI Gene alias (LOC542452), not the paper table.
ABA 8-hydroxylase; SC-specific in snRNA only (Sun 2022 Fig 3C).
ABA/nitrate transporter (oocyte assays); SC-enriched in snRNA, weak in GC (Sun 2022). v4 maps to two v5 models (eb385450, eb385460).
Beta-galactosidase; GMC-specific reporter in transgenic maize (Sun 2022 Fig 4H). v4 gene maps to two unnamed v5 models (eb146100, eb146110): check both.

LRR receptor-like protein polarizing the asymmetric SMC division (Cartwright et al. 2009 Science); SMC substate in Sun 2022 (no validation there). ID from MaizeGDB symbol pan1; v5 model also maps back to Zm00001d031437.

bHLH for the GMC-to-guard-cell transition; Sun 2022 used ZmFAMA for GMC/YGC but its ID is only in the inaccessible supplement. This ID is the NCBI RefSeq transcription factor FAMA (LOC103635409) by homology only: confirm.
GDSL lipase; reporter in young and mature stomatal complexes (GC+SC) in transgenic maize (Sun 2022 Fig 4F). Marks the whole complex, not one cell.
MAP kinase; EMS mutant impaired in CO2-induced closure; GC+SC reporter in transgenic rice (Sun 2022). v4 gene maps to two v5 models (eb415930, eb415940 mpk4): check both.

SBP TF required for ligule and auricle, expressed in the preligule band (Moreno et al. 1997 Genes Dev); marks leaf-base cluster 10 in Sun 2022. Only in leaf-base samples. Ortholog of sorghum_leaf.tsv LG1.
Class I KNOX, excluded from leaf primordia; marks the snRNA meristem cluster C18 in Zhao 2024 shoot-base sample. Presence signals SAM/stem contamination or blade-sheath boundary cells.
Class I KNOX; marks Zhao 2024 C18 with RS1. Same caveat.
APC/C activator of G2/M; top gene of Yi 2026 G2/M c7 (pct 0.95 vs 0.17).
B-type cyclin of G2/M; marks the Zhao 2024 snRNA G2/M cluster C1.
Replication-dependent histone H2B; S-phase cluster c3 in Yi 2026 (also c4).
Ribonucleotide reductase small subunit (dNTP supply in S phase); S-phase marker in Yi 2026 Table S5.
